lines.en: What separates champions from ordinary players is not talent alone, but the will to train when nobody is watching.
The match is said to have been one of the most exciting finals in the history of the tournament.
Not until the final minute did the team score the goal that made them champions.
However talented a player may be, no one wins a team game alone.
It is often the quietest player in training who surprises everyone on the day of the match.
Were the referee to watch the replay, he would surely change his decision.
What the fans remember is not the score, but the moment the whole stadium stood up.
Little did anyone expect that the youngest player on the field would decide the final.
Losing a final is painful, but it teaches a team lessons that victory never could.
It is believed that regular sport in childhood builds confidence that lasts a lifetime.
